headline_marked: [[Google Infiltrates]] Notorious Supply-Chain Hacking Gang TeamPCP
headline: Google Infiltrates Notorious Supply-Chain Hacking Gang TeamPCP
summary: Google's threat intelligence group had an undercover analyst within the hacker group TeamPCP, monitoring their spree of supply-chain attacks from the inside.
details: Google's threat intelligence group revealed it had an undercover researcher embedded within the notorious hacker group TeamPCP. This mole allowed Google to monitor the group's extensive supply-chain hacking campaign from the inside, enabling them to warn potential targets and disrupt attacks.

TeamPCP is accused of compromising hundreds of open-source programs with malware, stealing developer accounts, and releasing a Dune-themed worm to automate its attacks. The group's actions ultimately breached over a thousand companies, including major entities like GitHub and OpenAI.

The infiltration began in March, just as TeamPCP intensified its supply-chain attacks. Google's undercover analyst, part of the Mandiant subsidiary, gained access to the group's core chat, 'CanisterWorm,' providing real-time intelligence on their operations.

This inside perspective proved crucial. Google was able to gather identifying details that were passed on to law enforcement, contributing to the arrest of two alleged Australian members of TeamPCP last month. The group first appeared online in late 2025.

TeamPCP's modus operandi involved repeatedly compromising open-source software to hide its malware. This malicious code was then used to hijack developer credentials, allowing the hackers to inject their code into other widely used tools, creating a cascading effect.

Notable targets of TeamPCP's supply-chain attacks included the open-source security scanner Trivy, the AI API tool LiteLLM, and infrastructure of the web application security firm Checkmarx. The group also compromised the enterprise AI platform Mistral AI.

Google received additional intelligence from ShinyHunters, another cybercriminal group that had partnered with TeamPCP but later turned against them. This collaboration provided further insights into TeamPCP's activities and their network.

The undercover operation highlights the sophisticated methods employed by tech giants to combat cyber threats. Google's ability to monitor and disrupt such a widespread campaign demonstrates the critical role of threat intelligence in safeguarding the digital ecosystem.
